text: If we write the characteristic equation for the matrix $ A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} -4 \amp 4 \\ -12 \amp 10 \\ \end{array}\right] $, we see that $$ \begin{aligned} \det(A-\lambda I) \amp {}={} 0 \\ \\ \det \left[\begin{array}{rr} -4 - \lambda \amp 4 \\ -12 \amp 10 - \lambda \\ \end{array}\right] \amp {}={} 0 \\ \\ (-4-\lambda)(10-\lambda) + 48 \amp {}={} 0 \\ \lambda^2-6\lambda + 8 {}={} 0 \\ (\lambda-4)(\lambda-2) {}={} 0\text{.} \\ \end{aligned} $$ This shows us that the eigenvalues are $\lambda = 4$ and $\lambda=2$.
